title: Hypothesis registry for chitin-reinforced SCOBY biocomposite via controlled fungal biomass incorporation
scope: Investigate whether a controlled, contained fungal-biomass pathway can produce a cellulose-containing SCOBY composite with altered mechanical and moisture properties. This is a materials-science hypothesis, not a food, medical, agricultural, or home-culture protocol.
hypothesis_statement: A cellulose matrix containing a measurable chitin-containing fungal biomass fraction may exhibit altered tensile, tear, wet-state, fracture, and moisture behavior relative to matched pure-SCOBY controls. The direction and magnitude of the effect are unverified and may be offset by fungal biodegradation of the cellulose network.

CHITIN_BIOMASS_CANDIDATE.description: Contained research branch in which a validated fungal biomass system is evaluated for formation of a chitin-containing phase within or on a SCOBY-derived cellulose matrix, followed by validated inactivation and downstream characterization.
CHITIN_BIOMASS_CANDIDATE.candidate_organism_policy: Use only a traceable, institutionally approved strain with documented morphology, biosafety classification, and cellulolytic profile. Specific species selection and cultivation parameters remain under laboratory SOP control.
CHITIN_BIOMASS_CANDIDATE.safety_note: All viable fungal work must follow the approved containment and biosafety SOP of the laboratory. This registry does not provide or authorize a home inoculation recipe.

CONTROL_PURE_SCOBY.description: Matched SCOBY matrix processed through the same non-biological handling, conditioning, inactivation, and drying workflow without fungal biomass.
CONTROL_PURE_SCOBY.purpose: Isolate the effect of fungal biomass/chitin from processing and conditioning effects.

CHITIN_DIRECT_ADDITION.description: Non-biological comparator in which a characterized chitin or chitosan material is incorporated using a separately validated materials-processing protocol.
CHITIN_DIRECT_ADDITION.note: Provides a positive comparator for the mechanical contribution of a chitin-containing phase without requiring live fungal growth.

FUNGAL_BIOMASS_ONLY.description: Characterized fungal biomass or cell-wall fraction analyzed independently to provide composition and mechanical-reference data.

required_evidence: FTIR or Raman evidence consistent with chitin-containing material
XRD where crystalline phase identification is informative
elemental nitrogen increase relative to matched pure-SCOBY control
mass fraction estimate with explicit uncertainty
competing_hypotheses_to_reject: nitrogen originates primarily from residual proteins or media components
fungal material is surface-adhered without meaningful matrix incorporation
observed phase is non-chitinous fungal biomass
apparent reinforcement is caused by densification rather than the chitin-containing phase

required_evidence: SEM cross-section showing biomass distribution and penetration depth
fracture-surface imaging to assess cellulose-fungal interface
AFM or TEM where needed to resolve fibrillar architecture
porosity comparison with matched pure-SCOBY control

G3_MECHANICAL_FUNCTION.comparison_rule: All metrics must be compared against a matched pure-SCOBY control processed identically and, where appropriate, against GEN1 baseline data from SCOBY-D1-STAGE1.

gating_sequence: G3_MECHANICAL_FUNCTION (prove net reinforcement over matched control)
APPLICATION_CLAIM only after all gates passed

safety_boundary.fungal_work: Live fungal cultures are laboratory-only and must remain within the approved containment, biosafety, decontamination, and waste-management framework. This record does not authorize culturing environmental mold at home.
safety_boundary.inactivation: Inactivation must be validated by an appropriate laboratory method before material leaves containment; visual absence of growth is not sufficient.
safety_boundary.inhalation: Dried composites and fungal biomass fractions may generate respirable particles; downstream processing requires appropriate engineering controls and PPE.
safety_boundary.chemical_fixation: Solvent-based fixation and any flammable reagents require the approved laboratory handling SOP.
safety_boundary.food_boundary: This material is not intended for food contact, ingestion, medical use, or agricultural deployment.
safety_boundary.disposal: Biological material must be decontaminated using the approved institutional procedure before disposal.

decision_logic.if_chitin_signal_present_but_matrix_inte: Hypothesis not supported in the tested process window; investigate direct chitin addition or alternative validated materials routes.
decision_logic.if_chitin_signal_is_confirmed_and_mechan: Hypothesis partially supported; quantify composition-structure-property relationship before optimization.
decision_logic.if_mechanics_improve_but_chitin_signal_i: Do not attribute improvement to chitin; investigate densification, drying, crosslinking, or other process artifacts.
decision_logic.if_wet_retention_improves: Treat as a functional observation requiring independent replication, not as an application claim.

replication.minimum_exploratory_design: At least three independent replicates per comparison condition before comparative material claims.
replication.rule: n=3 is exploratory replication and is not sufficient by itself for strong generalization.

next_gate: REGISTER_A_CONTAINED_AND_APPROVED_FUNGAL_BIOMASS COMPARISON USING MATCHED CONTROLS; COMPLETE CHITIN IDENTITY/QUANTIFICATION, STRUCTURAL IMAGING, AND MECHANICAL TESTING; PRESERVE ALL COMPETING EXPLANATIONS UNTIL DISCRIMINATED.
